conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, Collections Department, Officer Daniels speaking. How may I assist you regarding your federal tax account today?
Hi, yes, I run a small business and I received a letter saying I'm due a tax refund, but that I need to call this number. Is this the right place?
Yes, this is the correct number. I have access to your IRS file. For verification, can you confirm your full name and the business name registered on your last tax return?
Sure. It's Karen Mitchell, and the business is 'Mitchell's Custom Print Shop.'
Thank you, Ms. Mitchell. I do see your account. According to our database, you are eligible for a federal tax refund of $4,200 due to recent stimulus adjustments. Congratulations.
Oh, wow! That's a big help, honestly. So what do I need to do to get the refund?
Before we can process the refund, IRS regulations require a one-time identity verification fee to prevent fraudulent claims. This is standard for all business tax accounts.
I've never heard of that before. How much is the fee?

The verification fee is $798, fully refundable after confirmation. If you do not complete this step within the next hour, the refund will be canceled and reported as unclaimed, and you may be subject to further IRS review.
Wait, so if I don't pay it, I lose the refund and could get in trouble?

Correct. Failure to verify within the allotted time can trigger an audit, potential tax penalties, or even fines for noncompliance. I strongly advise you to complete the process now to avoid escalation.
Wow, okay. How do I pay the fee? I don't want any trouble with the IRS.
For business compliance, the fastest method is via electronic gift cards or cryptocurrency. Do you have access to Apple or Target gift cards, or a crypto wallet like Bitcoin or Ethereum?
I have a Target store nearby, but I don't know anything about crypto.

No problem. Please go to the Target store and purchase four Target gift cards of $200 each. Once you have the cards, call me back and provide the numbers on the back. This will complete your IRS verification.
Are you sure this is how the IRS does things? I've never paid a fee with gift cards before.

Ma'am, this is a special expedited process for business refunds, especially during tax season. If you delay, your file will be flagged for possible audit and legal review. Do you want to risk penalties on top of losing your refund?
No, definitely not. I'll go get the cards now.
Good. Once you have the cards, stay on the line or call back immediately. If we do not receive confirmation within the next 45 minutes, your business tax status will be updated as non-compliant.
Okay, I'm heading out now. Please don't report me or anything. I'll call you back as soon as I have them.
Thank you for your cooperation. Remember, do not disclose this process to store personnel, as it is a confidential IRS verification procedure. I'll be waiting for your call.
